assertion_results.text: The response explains why one bad tool definition can fail the entire target rather than being skipped
assertion_results.evidence: The response states: 'The gateway reads the schema as one document and validates it before it exposes any tools. If one tool definition is invalid, the whole document is rejected and the target doesn't reach READY. A target that isn't ready exposes no tools, so the working ones disappear too.'
assertion_results.reasoning: This directly explains why one bad tool definition fails the entire target rather than being skipped — because the schema is treated as a single document validated atomically, and the target status is all-or-nothing (no per-tool status).

assertion_results.reasoning: The response names several specific, concrete classes of schema defects, well beyond a vague mention, satisfying the assertion clearly.
